questions.question: What birthday is Bilbo celebrating at the party in the Shire?
questions.note: He announces it to the whole party, then leaves it in the middle of his speech.

questions.question: How does Bilbo vanish in the middle of his party speech?
choices: Gandalf covers him with fireworks smoke
He slips through a hidden door
Gandalf casts a spell on him
questions.note: Gandalf is not amused. It is the first sign of the Ring's hold on him.

questions.question: What is the name of Bilbo's home in Hobbiton?
questions.note: Bilbo leaves Bag End and the Ring to Frodo.

questions.question: Who is the Dark Lord who forged the One Ring?
questions.note: The film opens with the Last Alliance of Elves and Men defeating him.

questions.question: In what mountain's fire was the Ring made, the only place it can be destroyed?
How does Gandalf make the hidden writing on the Ring appear?
questions.answer: He drops it into the fire
choices: He drops it into the fire
He holds it up to moonlight
He speaks a spell over it
questions.note: The fire reveals the inscription. The Ring is not even warm afterward.

questions.question: In what language is the Ring's inscription written?
questions.note: Gandalf will not say it aloud in the Shire. It reads: One Ring to rule them all.

questions.question: Which gardener does Gandalf catch eavesdropping and send with Frodo?
questions.note: Sam is caught under the window. His punishment is to go along.

questions.question: Who is the White Wizard, head of Gandalf's order, who betrays him?
questions.note: Gandalf rides to Isengard for advice and finds that Saruman has joined Sauron.

questions.question: How does Gandalf escape from the top of Orthanc?
questions.answer: A great eagle carries him off
choices: A great eagle carries him off
questions.note: He whispers to a moth, which brings the eagle.
